description: Workdays capacity calendar — Working-day and capacity calendar for a whole year: workdays, work hours and holidays per month and per quarter, with US federal holidays on their observed dates (or none), any weekend pattern (weekend=sat,sun or fri,sat), company holidays (extra_holidays=YYYY-MM-DD,...), half days (half_days=), hours per day (hours=8), PTO to subtract (pto_days=), an hourly rate for revenue capacity (rate=) and fiscal years (fiscal_start=10 gives FY ending in year). Use for staffing, billing targets, payroll and project planning. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_workdays_calendar
